summary: Updates header fields of a Direct Issue document.
description:
Updates one or more header fields on an existing Direct Issue document. Editable fields are state-specific:
- In Draft state, name, issued_to, and notes are editable.
- In Final state, only notes is editable.
- Set void to true (admin only, behind materials_management_void-enabled) to void a Final
  Direct Issue. Optional notes may be sent with the void. Voiding zeros all line-location
  quantities in place (rows are kept), reverses the hidden transfer inventory impact, and
  sets header status to VOID.
The associated Requirement can be set or cleared with associated_requirement_id while the Direct Issue has no line items. Send a uuid to set it (the Requirement must be Final), "" to remove it, or omit/null to leave it unchanged.
Moving a Requirement-linked Direct Issue to Final returns 422 when quantity already issued plus this issue exceeds that line's quantity assigned, and also when this issue exceeds quantity remaining to be issued.
